assertion: The incoming House and Senate freshman classes are the largest in decades.
inaccuracy: Senate 19 new members is the most since 1979 (20); House count is 105 chip-holders at the Nov 17 lottery (some trackers say 109-110), which beats every class since 1993 (108 pre-convening, 110 per Vital Statistics) only if the final count reaches 109+.
warehouse_value: officials.members holds only Congresses 117-119; no 120th Congress rows, so the new-class count could not be computed in the warehouse
measure: members of Congress first elected term start year
independent_value: Senate 19 new (CBS); House 105 at lottery (Cronkite News), 109 (tracker); history.house.gov: 103rd Congress 108 pre-convening, 112th 99
